answer: An escrow bond and an open referral graph stop fakes. Each agent posts a 60 POA bond locked 20 epochs, and referral links are public, so a shell cluster shows as a star-shaped signal. Peers may dispute it; success slashes the fakes' and referrer's bonds. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 POA, lost on detection, more than fakes earn. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps a record clean as a pearl and earns undiluted rewards, set in basalt.
